FWM.Menu.Name: PNG → WebP Migrator
FWM.Menu.Label: Open Migrator
FWM.Menu.Hint: Scan PNG/WebP references, audit disk files, run external cwebp, and safely repair paths.
FWM.Header.Title: FBL WebP Migrator
FWM.Header.Description: Migration and consistency checks use verifiable stages. Back up Data and the world first.
FWM.Workflow.Scan: Scan selected documents and export a manifest containing PNG and WebP references.
FWM.Workflow.Convert: Audit consistency or convert PNG files with the external tool.
FWM.Workflow.Apply: Apply only verified changes and export a migration report.
FWM.Workflow.Cleanup: Dry-run cleanup, quarantine PNG files, and restore if needed.
FWM.Sections.ScanHint: Chat Messages covers only messages loaded in the current Foundry session. Package compendiums are an expert mode.
FWM.Sections.ConvertHint: The script validates PNG/WebP structure, dimensions, APNG, hashes, symlinks/junctions, and Data-root identity.
FWM.Sections.CleanupWarning: Cleanup is allowed only for concrete files with verified hashes. Run a dry-run first. --delete moves PNG files to quarantine instead of destroying them.
FWM.Cleanup.PermanentNote: Irreversible deletion requires both --delete and --permanent-delete. Use it only after a separate world check and backup.

FWM.Confirm.ApplyBody: Every field will be rechecked before writing. Stale references and unverified files will not be changed.
FWM.Confirm.AssumeBody: Foundry cannot verify files on disk. This mode may replace references but never authorizes cleanup. Use it only after manually verifying the WebP files.
FWM.Confirm.AssumeTitle: Do the WebP files already exist?
FWM.Confirm.PackageBody: Only already-unlocked package packs will be changed. A module or system update may overwrite these changes.
FWM.Confirm.ResetBody: The manifest, reports, and rollback history will be removed from application memory. Foundry files and documents will not be changed.
FWM.Confirm.RollbackBody: Only references changed by the saved migration reports will be restored. Files on disk are not changed.
FWM.Errors.GmOnly: FBL WebP Migrator is available only to a GM.
FWM.Errors.ImportManifestFirst: Create or import a manifest first.
FWM.Errors.ManifestAndReportRequired: A manifest and conversion report are required.
FWM.Errors.NoRollback: No saved references are available for rollback.
FWM.Status.ApplyDone: Changed references: {changed}. Files ready for quarantine: {files}.
FWM.Status.AssumedReady: The unverified report is ready. Cleanup is forbidden for these files.
FWM.Status.Error: Error. Details were written to the console.
FWM.Status.ManifestImported: Manifest imported: {count} PNG paths and {webpCount} WebP paths.
FWM.Status.MigrationImported: Migration report imported: {count} references are available for rollback.
FWM.Status.ScanDone: Done: {paths} PNG paths, {webpPaths} WebP paths, {refs} PNG references, {webpRefs} WebP references, {documents} documents.
FWM.Sections.ConsistencyHint: The command checks both sides of every pair on disk. The module changes only unambiguously verified paths and does not modify files.
FWM.Consistency.UnresolvedDetail: Automatic repair is not safe for the whole path pair.
FWM.Confirm.ConsistencyBody: Only verified safe cases will be changed: a PNG reference when a valid WebP exists, and a WebP reference when the WebP is missing or invalid but a valid PNG remains. Ambiguous cases stay unchanged.
FWM.Errors.ManifestAndConsistencyRequire: A manifest and consistency report are required.
FWM.Status.ConsistencyImported: Audit imported: {forward} paths can move to WebP and {reverse} can return to PNG.
FWM.Status.ConsistencyApplied: Changed references: {changed}. To WebP: {forward}. To PNG: {reverse}.
